title.evidence_quote: PhD & Master in Advanced Computing - Tsinghua University

qualifications: Foreign nationals who do not hold Chinese nationality
Degree (or CSCSE authentication for overseas degrees) before Tsinghua graduate registration in 2027
Non-native English speakers: TOEFL iBT 85 (tests before 21 January 2026) / 4.5 (tests from 21 January 2026) or IELTS 6.5
Two recommendation letters from associate professors or above, or senior professionals in a related field
Chinese Government Scholarship applicants are strongly encouraged to apply in the first round
description_short: Tsinghua University's English-taught PhD and Master programmes in Advanced Computing admit international students for 2027. The first application round closes 15 December 2026 (17:00 Beijing time); a second round runs 1 January to 27 February 2027.
status_evidence: Official programme page (search results): first round before Dec 15, 2026 (17:00); second round Jan 1 - Feb 27, 2027
